title: Jazzy Velvety Russian Egg Frittata
description: A funky Russian dish featuring mustard and bonito flakes, perfect for a brunch mood, with a raw-friendly twist
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Sprinkle the shaved bonito flakes and chopped fresh dill over the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top, if using.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and garnish with chopped scallions.
